fields.summary_ko.0: Broadcom (AVGO) AI semiconductor revenue surged 221% year-over-year to $17 billion in Q3, but current stock price near year-low of $326.08 trades at 18x net earnings multiple.
fields.summary_ko.1: CEO Hock Tan expects fiscal 2028 EPS to exceed $30, suggesting potential $600 target price (20x multiple); consensus target price is $530.14 (implying 62.6% upside).
fields.summary_ko.2: AVGO faces headwinds from increasing customer concentration quarter-over-quarter and downward guidance revision on net profit margin (75% to 73%) despite 85.5% total revenue growth, declining 5.52% recently.
